# temps_status_page_maintenance (Resource)

A scheduled maintenance window shown on a status page; its monitors are not counted as down while it runs. Destroying the resource cancels the window.

Import with `<status_page_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `status_page:create`, `status_page:read`, `status_page:write`, `status_page:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_status_page_maintenance" "db_upgrade" {
  status_page_id = temps_status_page.public.id
  title          = "Database upgrade"
  description    = "Writes may be slow for a few minutes."
  starts_at      = "2030-01-01T02:00:00Z"
  ends_at        = "2030-01-01T03:00:00Z"
  monitor_ids    = [temps_monitor.web.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String) End, RFC 3339.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the monitors under maintenance.
- `starts_at` (String) Start, RFC 3339 (`2030-01-01T02:00:00Z`).
- `status_page_id` (Number) ID of the status page.
- `title` (String) Title shown to visitors.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the maintenance is about.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<status_page_id>/<id>`.
- `state` (String) `scheduled`, `in_progress` or `completed`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <status_page_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_status_page_maintenance.db_upgrade 3/7
```
